title: SDLC Task Review v1
description: The task-specific payload for reviewing one exact result produced by any supported SDLC task kind. Intent declares the review target, policy reference, criteria, evidence requirements, non-goals, and prompt context. Result records the review execution, reproducibility data, criterion evaluations, findings, decision, limitations, and non-claims. The payload deliberately has only the two high-level properties intent and result; task identity, processing state, routing, dependencies, and the common task wrapper remain owned by https://schemas.handschuh.dev/sdlc/task-envelope/v1.
$comment: A review decision is not a lifecycle mutation. Host validation must resolve the target task and exact result, verify targetResult.sha256, resolve policyRef against https://schemas.handschuh.dev/sdlc/policy-review/v1, verify that policy and prompt digests are current, enforce authorization and self-approval rules, confirm required evidence and criteria coverage, validate that accepted decisions have no policy-blocking unsatisfied criteria or findings, and apply any resulting lifecycle action explicitly. Agent-produced findings and decisions are claims to evaluate; policy compliance and lifecycle effects are host-derived. Approval of one result does not transfer to a later result with a different digest. Evidence-tier fields use the canonical vocabulary from https://schemas.handschuh.dev/sdlc/evidence-tier/v1; the enum is repeated locally so nested examples remain synchronously authorable.
